JOB SUMMARY:
The Software Engineer supports North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD) Cheyenne Mountain Complex (NCMC) Integrated Tactical Warning/Attack Assessment (ITW/AA) and Space Support Contract II (NISSC II). The candidate will work closely with other software engineers on the program to produce reliable mission software that meets customer requirements. They will also develop and maintain mission software with proper code quality, security, and testing in mind. Candidate should have experience developing and integrating applications and familiarity with containerization technology.
SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:
Must have or obtain within 90 days of start date IAT Level II Certification (Security+ CE or equivalent
Understanding of the Java programming language
Preferred - Experience with Java project management tools, such as Maven or Gradle
Developing microservices using Java Spring Boot and Spring Cloud
Developing technical solutions to meet defined requirements
Writing event-driven applications utilizing a messaging service
Work with REST API, containers, and containerizing applications
Work within an Agile development team
REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Experience developing, integrating, and maintaining applications
Preferred - Experience developing application front-ends using React or other JavaScript-based web frameworks
Preferred - Experience with JavaScript / Typescript / React project management tools, such as npm or yarn
Preferred - Experience creating, maintaining, and troubleshooting Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) within a DevSecOps pipeline
EDUCATION: Bachelors Degree preferred
Years of Experience: 0-3
LOCATION: Full Time/ On-Site in Colorado Springs, CO
CLEARANCE REQUIRMENT:  Secret or ability to obtain
DOD 8570 REQUIREMENT: IAT - Level II
SALARY RANGE: $65,000 to $72,000
